mentions.author: dnquark
mentions.text:
Hastie and Tibshirani teach a free course based on this book on Stanford's OpenEdX ( [course]). I highly recommend taking this course or reading the book before delving into ESL. IMO, ESL is excellent as a reference, but trying to learn by reading it linearly is not an optimal time investment.

Now if only a similar course existed for Wasserman's "All of Statistics..."
